style.backgroundSystem: flat sky-blue #7CB4D0 screens and cream-apricot #FADFBE screens joined by scalloped wave dividers and soft cartoon cloud shapes; packshots and infographic cards sit on clean white #FFFFFF rounded panels with 16px corner radius
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight paw icons and dot-cluster pictograms in #EEE43A or #FFFFFF, capsule-shaped subtitle badges, thin dotted orbit rings, arch-shaped cards, rounded rectangular photo frames, hairline rules in #7CB4D0
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio key from the front-left at 5200K-5500K with bounce fill, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows only, never harsh speculars; scene screens use natural window light from the left
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute premium pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of sky-blue panel #7CB4D0, cream-apricot panel #FADFBE, clean white #FFFFFF sweep and one sunny accent #EEE43A with charcoal text #3A3A3A; warm cheerful tone; modern rounded geometric sans-serif with one headline weight per screen and capsule sub-badges; background system of flat sky-blue and cream panels joined by scalloped wave dividers and soft cartoon cloud shapes; bright soft studio key from the front-left at 5200K-5500K with bounce fill, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows only; laminate squeeze tube and carton held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with true matte print finish; infographic components of thin-line paw icons, dotted orbit rings, arch-shaped cards and rounded rectangular photo frames with 16px corner radius; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no medical iconography.
noDrift: no medical or veterinary iconography such as crosses, shields, organs or body diagrams
no cartoon style drift into photoreal 3D
style.presentationRules: laminate squeeze tube and its carton always at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, matte print finish true to the reference, tube upright with cap down on a podium, product grounded by a contact shadow, cat shown cropped above the ears or from behind so no animal identity reads, packaging print never restyled
style.surfaceSystem: matte white display podium, matte cream board #FADFBE, light-oak home counter #E3C9A8, glossy ceramic dish #FFFFFF
style.typography: modern rounded geometric sans-serif, one headline weight per screen; Chinese headline 28-44pt, capsule sub-label 14-20pt, spec row label 16pt; headline in accent #EEE43A on sky-blue screens and in #3A3A3A on light screens, all copy carried as placeholders
